summary.title: About | Divio Documentation (The Documentation System)
summary.one_liner: Documentation has four distinct purposes (tutorials, how-to guides, technical reference, explanation), and each needs its own writing approach.
takeaways: Good documentation is really four kinds: tutorials, how-to guides, technical reference, and explanation.
Each of the four serves a different purpose and needs a different approach to writing.
Separating these types makes documentation clearer and more useful, according to the author.
The system is presented as widely adopted across open and proprietary projects, and a video presentation from PyCon Australia 2017 is linked.
summary.summary: This page introduces the Divio documentation system, described by David Laing as a "Grand Unified Theory of Documentation." It argues that software documentation is four different things with four different purposes: tutorials, how-to guides, technical reference, and explanation. The page is an overview with a site outline of these sections and a link to a PyCon Australia 2017 video, and it does not go into detailed step-by-step guidance on this page itself. The author states the system is simple, broadly applicable, and used in many fields, though the page gives few concrete details beyond that.
